nodes.label: Circle
nodes.description: Analytic circle collider. Cheap.

nodes.label: FromLayer
nodes.description: Build a collider from any shape layer (rect, ellipse, polygon, triangle).

nodes.label: Rect
nodes.description: Axis-aligned rectangle collider.

nodes.label: Color
nodes.description: Build a colour. Pick mode (rgb / hsl / hex) and the input pins adapt.

nodes.label: Gradient
nodes.description: Sample a gradient of color stops at t ∈ [0, 1]. `space` picks how neighbouring stops blend: rgb, oklab (perceptually even) or oklch (round the hue wheel).

nodes.label: Hex
nodes.description: Legacy — use the unified Color node instead.

nodes.label: HSL
nodes.description: Legacy — use the unified Color node instead.

nodes.label: Lerp
nodes.description: Blend from a to b by t. `space` picks how: rgb mixes the channels (fast, but a blend between strong colours dips through grey); oklab blends perceptually, evenly and without muddy midpoints; oklch walks round the hue wheel, keeping colours vivid.

nodes.label: Palette
nodes.description: A list of colours. `mode` stops: author them by clicking swatches. cosine: Inigo Quilez's a + b·cos(2π(c·t + d)) per channel, sampled `count` times round one cycle (a = centre, b = contrast, c = how many times each channel cycles, d = phase). complementary, analogous, triadic, split, tetradic: colour harmonies — the base colour and its hue turned round the colour wheel (analogous / split use `angle`).

nodes.label: RGB
nodes.description: Legacy — use the unified Color node instead.

nodes.label: SetAlpha
nodes.description: Replace the alpha channel (0..255) of a color.

nodes.label: SplitColor
nodes.description: Decompose a colour into channels. Pick mode (rgb or hsl); alpha is exposed in both.

nodes.label: SplitHSL
nodes.description: Legacy — use the unified SplitColor node instead.

nodes.label: SplitRGB
nodes.description: Legacy — use the unified SplitColor node instead.

nodes.label: ToBool
nodes.description: Convert any value to a boolean.

nodes.label: ToDegrees
nodes.description: Scale a unit value [0, 1] to degrees [0, 360].

nodes.label: ToInt
nodes.description: Round any value to the nearest integer.

nodes.label: ToNumber
nodes.description: Convert any value to a number.

nodes.label: ToRadians
nodes.description: Convert an angle from degrees to radians.

nodes.label: ToString
nodes.description: Convert any value to a string.

nodes.label: CSVInline
nodes.description: Parse inline CSV data into a number spread.

nodes.label: CSVFile
nodes.description: Load the numbers in a CSV file (a path relative to the patch, a URL, or a File node's url) into a number spread. Pick a column, or -1 for every cell.

nodes.label: Arc
nodes.description: Draw an arc segment from `start` to `stop` radians.

nodes.label: Ellipse
nodes.description: Draw an ellipse anchored at `pos`. `anchor` picks which point of the bounding box `pos` is — center (default) or a corner (tl/tr/bl/br).

nodes.label: Image
nodes.description: Draw an image at `pos` with size (w, h).

nodes.label: ImageRegion
nodes.description: Draw a sub-rectangle of an image onto a destination rect.

nodes.label: ImageTile
nodes.description: Tile an image `cols × rows` times across a rect.

nodes.label: Line
nodes.description: Draw a line from point `a` to point `b`.

nodes.label: Path
nodes.description: Stroke a path through a spread of vec2 points. Tension > 0 turns straight lines into Catmull–Rom curves. Wire `widths` to taper.

nodes.label: Point
nodes.description: Draw a single point at `pos`.

nodes.label: Polygon
nodes.description: Draw a polygon from a spread of vec2 points. Optionally wire a `widths` spread to taper the stroke into a filled offset polygon.

nodes.label: Quad
nodes.description: Draw a quadrilateral from four corner points.

nodes.label: Rect
nodes.description: Draw a rectangle anchored at `pos`. `anchor` picks which point of the box `pos` is — center (default) or a corner (tl/tr/bl/br).

nodes.label: Text
nodes.description: Draw a text string at `pos`.

nodes.label: Triangle
nodes.description: Draw a triangle from three corner points.

nodes.label: WalkerCluster
nodes.description: Spawn a cluster of random walkers that paint trails and circles.

nodes.label: Font
nodes.description: A font for `style/text-params`: an installed family, or a font file (.ttf, .otf, .ttc, .woff, .woff2) — a file wins. Lists the font’s variation axes (tag, min, default, max).

nodes.label: Glyphs
nodes.description: Text split into shaped glyphs, laid out like `draw/text`. `shape` draws them all; per glyph: a layer drawn at the origin (translate it to its position), its baseline position, advance, source characters and character index — for kinetic type in a ForEach.

nodes.label: Text on Path
nodes.description: Lay text along a path — a point spread, or a wired `path` layer (`draw/path`, polygon, line, ellipse). Each glyph turns to the tangent. `offset` slides the text along, `shift` lifts it off the path; `closed` wraps around a loop.

nodes.label: Text Outline
nodes.description: Points sampled along the glyph outlines (`outline`) or on a grid inside them (`fill`), every `spacing` units, laid out like `draw/text` — for particles from type, morphing, plotter-style lines. With each point’s contour and glyph index.

nodes.label: Text Animate
nodes.description: Animate text glyph by glyph, no ForEach needed. Wire `draw/text`, Glyphs or Text on Path into `text`. `in`: each glyph eases (`ease`) from its start state — moved by `offset`, turned by `rotate` (radians), at `scale` and `opacity` — to its place as `progress` runs 0 → 1; `stagger` 0 moves all together, 1 one after another, in `order` (forward, backward, center, edges, random by `seed`). Run `progress` 1 → 0 to animate out. `wave`: `progress` is a phase (loop it 0..1); glyphs swing by `offset` / `rotate` and towards `scale` / `opacity`, `stagger` cycles apart. Glyphs turn and scale about their centres. `amounts`: each glyph's eased progress (or wave, −1..1).

nodes.label: Attractor
nodes.description: Radial pull toward a point. Negative strength = repulsion. Falloff curve baked at compile.

nodes.label: Drag
nodes.description: Velocity-proportional damping, applied per-particle.

nodes.label: Gravity
nodes.description: Uniform vector force (acts like gravity).

nodes.label: Repulsor
nodes.description: Radial push away from a point.

nodes.label: Turbulence
nodes.description: Perlin-noise vector field. Each particle gets a force from the local gradient; time drifts the field.

nodes.label: Vortex
nodes.description: Rotational force around a centre, with optional radial pull. Counter-clockwise when axisStrength > 0.

nodes.label: Wind
nodes.description: Directional force with optional noise variation. Mass-dependent (heavier = less push).

nodes.label: Shader
nodes.description: Fragment shader (ShaderToy-style) with optional Buffer A–D passes. Wire a layer for post-FX, or leave it for generative. Edit in the side panel. `history` > 0 keeps that many of the input's past frames for the passes (`iHistoryFrame(ago, uv)`, or `iHistory` with `iHistoryHead / Count / Size`).

nodes.label: Adjust
nodes.description: Adjust brightness, contrast, saturation, and hue.

nodes.label: Blend
nodes.description: Composite image B onto image A using the chosen blend mode.

nodes.label: Convolve
nodes.description: Apply a 3×3 convolution kernel (edge, sharpen, emboss).

nodes.label: Crop
nodes.description: Crop an image to the rectangle (sx, sy, sw, sh).

nodes.label: Dims
nodes.description: Read an image's pixel dimensions and aspect ratio.

nodes.label: Filter

nodes.label: Rasterize

nodes.label: ImageURL

nodes.label: Expression
nodes.description: Type a formula, e.g. `sin(x * 3) + y * t`. Every name it uses becomes an input pin; wire spreads in and it runs once per element (shorter spreads cycle). Built in: `t` (seconds) and `frame`, `index` / `count` (the element), `pi`, `tau`, `e`. Values can be numbers, vec2s or colours (channels 0..1): `p.x`, `c.r` read a component (and give that pin a vec2 / colour type); + − * / work per component. Operators: + - * / % (wraps negatives) ^, comparisons, && || !, `c ? a : b`. Functions: sin cos tan asin acos atan atan2 sinh cosh tanh exp log log2 log10 sqrt pow abs sign floor ceil round fract trunc mod min max clamp mix step smoothstep map hypot radians degrees noise(x, y, seed) vec2(x, y) length distance dot normalize angle rgb(r, g, b, a) hsl(h, s, l, a). Mistakes show on the node.

nodes.label: Mul

nodes.label: Neg

nodes.label: Pow

nodes.label: Round

nodes.label: Sqrt

nodes.label: StdDev

nodes.label: Step

nodes.label: Sub

nodes.label: Sum

nodes.label: Tan

nodes.label: Wrap

nodes.label: Comment

nodes.label: Probe

nodes.label: Subpatch
nodes.description: Group nodes behind a single boundary with custom ports.

nodes.label: DelayLine
nodes.description: Echo `value` (number, vec2, or color) as it was `delay` seconds ago (linearly interpolated). History clears on recompile.

nodes.label: Ease
nodes.description: Remap t ∈ [0,1] through an easing curve. Pick the curve from the dropdown.

nodes.label: LFO
nodes.description: Low-frequency oscillator: a value that cycles between `min` and `max`, `rate` times a second. Shapes: sine, triangle, saw, ramp-down, square (`width` = the high part of the cycle), random (a new value each cycle) and smooth-random. `offset` shifts the phase (0..1); a rising edge on `reset` restarts the cycle. With `bpm` above 0, `rate` counts cycles per beat (0.25 = once a bar in 4/4). With `count` > 1, `value` carries that many copies, each `spread / count` of a cycle behind the last (random shapes get one sequence per copy) — wire it into a ForEach to animate many things at once. `phase` is the 0..1 position in the cycle.

nodes.label: Smooth
nodes.description: Exponentially ease toward `value` (number, vec2, or color). Higher `rate` = snappier; frame-rate independent.

nodes.label: Spring
nodes.description: Spring-follow `value` (number, vec2, or color) with stiffness + damping — overshoots and settles.

nodes.label: Trigger
nodes.description: Emit a single-frame `true` pulse: on any change, a rising edge, or crossing `threshold` upward.

nodes.label: CurlNoise
nodes.description: Divergence-free flow field — the curl of a Perlin potential at `pos·scale`. Returns a vec2 you can use to advect particles in smooth swirls (no sources or sinks).

nodes.label: Noise
nodes.description: Smooth 2D noise at (pos + (x, y)) · scale, per element: wire spreads (a grid of positions, a list of seeds) into any pin for a spread of values. Modes: perlin, simplex, value, cellular (Worley — `feature` F1 = distance to the nearest cell point, F2 = to the second nearest, F2-F1 = cell edges) and curl (`flow` = the divergence-free curl of Perlin noise, for advecting things in swirls); plus three pattern fields: checker (1 / 0 on alternate unit squares), stripes (a smooth wave, one stripe per unit, turned by `angle` in radians) and rings (the same wave round the origin). With `warp`, stripes become marble and rings wood grain. `noise` is in [0, 1]. `octaves` > 1 adds finer layers (fBm), each `falloff` times as strong. `warp` pushes the sample point around by another noise field (`warp scale` = its frequency) for marbled, folded shapes. Perlin mode at default settings gives exactly what the old Perlin node gave.

nodes.description: Slice the bottom row from a 2D boolean grid.

nodes.label: LinearSpread
nodes.description: Generate a spread evenly stepping from `from` to `to`.

nodes.label: Merge
nodes.description: Combine multiple wires into one spread (each numbered slot takes one wire). Use it to feed several sources into a single input pin.

nodes.label: Neighbor
nodes.description: Read a neighbouring element by relative `offset` (e.g. -1 / +1). Inside a ForEach: broadcast the iterated spread into `spread` and wire the region's `index` pin. `edges` sets out-of-range behaviour: clamp (repeat ends), wrap (toroidal), or zero (empty).

nodes.label: NoiseSpread
nodes.description: 1-D Perlin noise sampled at regular intervals, in [0, 1].

nodes.label: PairwiseSpread
nodes.description: Adjacent pairs: outputs (s[0..n-1]) and (s[1..n]).

nodes.label: PartitionSpread
nodes.description: Chunk a spread into fixed-size groups. Outputs flat + groupSize.

nodes.label: PermuteSpread
nodes.description: Reorder elements by an index spread.

nodes.label: PickSpread
nodes.description: Index into `source` using each entry of `indices`. Output length = indices length; output[i] = source[indices[i] mod source.length]. Out-of-range indices wrap.

nodes.label: RandomizeSpread
nodes.description: Shuffle the input spread into a random order. Output length matches input; output type echoes input.

nodes.label: RangeSpread
nodes.description: Generate the integers 0, 1, …, count − 1.

nodes.label: RemoveSliceSpread
nodes.description: Delete `count` elements starting at `index`.

nodes.label: RepeatSpread
nodes.description: Repeat the input N times into a spread. A scalar becomes N copies; a spread of length K tiles to length N×K.

nodes.label: ResampleSpread
nodes.description: Resample a spread to a new length by linear interpolation.

nodes.label: ReverseSpread
nodes.description: Reverse the order of elements.

nodes.label: RingSpread
nodes.description: Lay `count` points evenly around a circle. `positions` are ready to place; `angles` (radians) drive orientation, spirals, or hue.

nodes.label: RotateSpread
nodes.description: Cyclic shift by N positions (negative shifts left).

nodes.label: ScrollUpSpread
nodes.description: Scroll a 2D boolean grid up one row and append newRow at the bottom.

nodes.label: SetSliceSpread
nodes.description: Replace element(s) at an index with another spread.

nodes.label: ShuffleSpread
nodes.description: Shuffle deterministically by seed.

nodes.label: SiftSpread
nodes.description: Keep elements where the parallel boolean spread is true.

nodes.label: SineSpread
nodes.description: Generate `count` samples of a sine wave.

nodes.label: SkipSpread
nodes.description: Drop the first N elements.

nodes.label: SliceSpread
nodes.description: Slice elements from start to end (end ≤ 0 counts from the end).

nodes.label: SortSpread
nodes.description: Sort numerically, ascending by default.

nodes.label: SortByKeySpread
nodes.description: Sort a spread by a parallel number spread.

nodes.label: SpiralSpread
nodes.description: Generate points along an Archimedean spiral.

nodes.label: StackSpread
nodes.description: Concatenate two spreads end-to-end.

nodes.label: SwapSpread
nodes.description: Swap two elements by index.

nodes.label: TakeSpread
nodes.description: Keep the first N elements.

nodes.label: Ungroup
nodes.description: Split a spread-of-spreads into one output pin per sub-spread (out 1…N). `count` sets the pins; missing groups emit empty spreads.

nodes.label: UninterleaveSpread
nodes.description: Split a spread into even- and odd-indexed elements.

nodes.label: UniqueSpread
nodes.description: Remove duplicates, preserving first occurrence.

nodes.label: WalkStepSpread
nodes.description: Advance a vec2 trail by one random-walk step.

nodes.label: WindowsSpread
nodes.description: Sliding windows of size N (stride 1). Outputs flat + windowSize.

nodes.label: Read
nodes.description: Emit the value last written under `slot`, or `init` on frame 0.

nodes.label: Read*
nodes.description: Emit the spread last written under `slot`, or `init` on frame 0.

nodes.label: StateSpread
nodes.description: Legacy: use Read* / Write* instead for left-to-right spread feedback.

nodes.label: State
nodes.description: Hold a single value across frames — emit last tick's `next` as `current`.

nodes.label: Write
nodes.description: Stash a value at end-of-tick; the matching Read emits it next tick.

nodes.label: Write*
nodes.description: Stash a spread at end-of-tick; the matching Read* emits it next tick.

nodes.label: Concat
nodes.description: Concatenate any number of strings into one. Wire multiple strings into `parts` (the pin gathers them); `separator` goes between each.

nodes.label: Length
nodes.description: Number of characters in the input string.

nodes.label: Split
nodes.description: Split a string into a Spread<string>. With `by=""` (default) you get one item per character; with `by=" "` one item per word.

nodes.label: WordIndices
nodes.description: For each character of `text`, output the word index that character belongs to. Words are separated by `by` (default " "). Separators themselves take the index of the word that just ended, so per-char colouring stays continuous.

nodes.label: Blur
nodes.description: Gaussian-blur downstream shapes by N pixels (fill, stroke, and text alike). 0 = sharp.

nodes.label: EllipseMode
nodes.description: Set how Ellipse interprets (x, y, w, h).

nodes.label: Fill
nodes.description: Set the fill colour for downstream shapes. Wire a Color node into `color`.

nodes.label: NoFill
nodes.description: Disable the fill on downstream shapes.

nodes.label: NoStroke
nodes.description: Disable the stroke on downstream shapes.

nodes.label: RectMode
nodes.description: Set how Rect interprets (x, y, w, h).

nodes.label: Stroke
nodes.description: Set the stroke colour, width, and alignment (center / inside / outside the outline). Alignment applies to closed shapes.

nodes.label: StrokeCap
nodes.description: Set the line end-cap shape.

nodes.label: StrokeJoin
nodes.description: Set how stroke corners are joined.

nodes.label: StrokeWeight
nodes.description: Set the stroke thickness in pixels.

nodes.label: TextParams
nodes.description: Override typographic style for downstream text — font family, weight, italic, alignment, kerning, line spacing.

nodes.label: FontVariations
nodes.description: Variable-font axes for downstream text, animatable per frame: weight (wght), width (wdth), slant (slnt), optical size (opsz), plus any axis by tag. 0 leaves an axis at the font’s default; chain nodes for more custom axes.

nodes.label: Delta
nodes.description: Seconds elapsed since the previous frame (dt) — for frame-rate-independent motion.

nodes.label: Frame
nodes.description: Output the integer frame counter.

nodes.label: Time
nodes.description: Output seconds elapsed since the patch started, and the loop phase: 0..1 over the patch's loop length (set in Export Video), so animations built on it loop perfectly.

nodes.label: ApplyMatrix
nodes.description: Apply an arbitrary 2D affine transform to a layer.

nodes.label: Blend
nodes.description: Composite a layer using the chosen blend mode.

nodes.label: Cache
nodes.description: Rasterise a layer into a cached bitmap and blit it.

nodes.label: Group
nodes.description: Combine multiple layer wires into one layer.

nodes.label: Rotate
nodes.description: Rotate a layer by `angle` radians around the origin.

nodes.label: Scale
nodes.description: Scale a layer by (sx, sy).

nodes.label: ShearX
nodes.description: Shear a layer along the X axis by `angle` radians.

nodes.label: ShearY
nodes.description: Shear a layer along the Y axis by `angle` radians.

nodes.label: Translate
nodes.description: Translate a layer by the vector `by`.

nodes.label: Number
nodes.description: Hold a constant number.

nodes.label: String
nodes.description: Hold a constant string.

nodes.label: Add
nodes.description: Add two vec2s component-wise.

nodes.label: AngleBetween
nodes.description: Signed angle from a to b, in radians.

nodes.label: Dist
nodes.description: Distance between two points.

nodes.label: Dot
nodes.description: Dot product of a and b.

nodes.label: FromAngle
nodes.description: Polar → cartesian: unit vector at `angle` radians, scaled by `mag` (radius).

nodes.label: Heading
nodes.description: Angle of the vector in radians.

nodes.label: Lerp
nodes.description: Linear interpolate between a and b at t ∈ [0, 1] (component-wise).

nodes.label: Limit
nodes.description: Clamp the magnitude to at most `max`.

nodes.label: Mag
nodes.description: Length of the vector.

nodes.label: Vec2
nodes.description: Build a vec2 from (x, y).

nodes.label: Mul
nodes.description: Component-wise multiply.

nodes.label: Normalize
nodes.description: Unit vector in the same direction. Zero vectors stay zero.

nodes.label: Project
nodes.description: Vector projection of `a` onto `b`.

nodes.label: Reflect
nodes.description: Reflect `v` across the surface with `normal` (normal is normalised internally).

nodes.label: Rotate
nodes.description: Rotate the vector by `angle` radians around the origin.

nodes.label: Scale
nodes.description: Multiply a vec2 by a scalar.

nodes.label: SetMag
nodes.description: Rescale the vector to the given magnitude.

nodes.label: Split
nodes.description: Decompose a vec2 into x and y.

nodes.label: Sub
nodes.description: Subtract b from a component-wise.

nodes.label: ToPolar
nodes.description: Cartesian → polar: decompose a vec2 into `angle` (radians) and `radius`.

nodes.label: VideoFile
nodes.description: Play a video file (MP4 / MOV) or an image sequence (numbered PNG / JPEG frames: pick one frame, or give a folder or a `name_####.png` pattern; played at `fps`) as an image. Pick a file on the node; `scrub` (0..1) overrides playback while wired.

nodes.label: VideoFrameAt
nodes.description: One frame of a video file or image sequence (at `fps`) at `time` seconds: random access without playback.

nodes.label: Scatter
nodes.description: Scatter points over a rectangle (`center`, `size`) or inside a wired `shape`. Modes: `poisson` (no two points closer than `distance`), `random` (`count` uniform points), `jittered-grid` (one point per `spacing` cell, moved up to `jitter` of a cell), `halton` (`count` evenly spread low-discrepancy points). The same `seed` gives the same points. Every mode takes `relax`: that many passes of Lloyd relaxation, spreading the points evenly over the area (random points become an even, organic spread with an exact count); mode `relax` spreads out wired `points` instead. Mode `stipple` draws `count` points that gather where a `density` image (stretched over the area) is dark (`invert`: light; `gamma` sharpens the contrast), relaxed by weighted Lloyd passes into even, organic dots that shade the picture.

nodes.label: Cells
nodes.description: Voronoi cells, Delaunay triangles or the convex hull of a points spread, as polygons. Voronoi cells are clipped to the `center` / `size` rectangle; `gap` leaves that much space between neighbours; `colors` fills polygon i with colour i (cycled). Outputs all polygons as one layer and one layer each (`cells`), their corners (`points`, flat) with `counts` per polygon (for `spread/at-group`), and each polygon's centre.

nodes.label: Path Ops
nodes.description: Reshape a point list (`points`, `closed`) or every outline of a wired `path` layer. Modes: `resample` (points evenly `spacing` apart), `smooth` (Chaikin corner cutting, `iterations` times), `subdivide` (insert midpoints, `iterations` times), `simplify` (drop points within `tolerance`), `offset` (grow by `distance`, shrink when negative; closed shapes get `join` corners, open paths shift sideways), `round-corners` (every corner an arc of `radius`), `thicken` (a `width`-wide stroke's outline as filled polygons, with `cap` ends and `join` corners), `wave` (a sine wave along the path: `amplitude`, `wavelength`; closed shapes fit whole waves), `noise` (Perlin wobble: `amount`, `scale`, `seed`), `twist` (swirl round `center` by `angle` radians, fading out at `radius`) and `explode` (every edge its own piece on `layers`, pushed `distance` from the centre). wave / noise / twist resample every `detail` units first; their `phase` loops every whole number. Shapes from a layer keep their own style unless `style` is wired.

nodes.label: Shape Boolean
nodes.description: Union, intersect, subtract (a − b) or xor the filled areas of two layers, as polygons (holes included). Closed shapes count (nonzero winding), lines don't; with only `a` wired, `union` merges its shapes. Drawn in the first shape's style unless `style` is wired.

nodes.label: L-System
nodes.description: Grow a string from `axiom` by `rules` (e.g. `F=F[+F]F[-F]F`; separate rules with `;`), `iterations` times, and draw it with a turtle: `F` / `G` draw a step, `f` / `g` move, `+` / `-` turn by `angle` degrees, `|` turns round, `[` / `]` branch; other symbols only rewrite. `fit` > 0 scales the drawing into a `fit`-wide box centred on `position` (0: start at `position`, `step` per move). `heading` in degrees (−90 = up); `jitter` varies every turn by up to that many degrees.

nodes.label: Trim Path
nodes.description: Draw-on / write-on: only the part of each outline between `start` and `end` (0..1 of its length), slid round by `offset` (wraps; animate it to run a dash round a loop). Reads a point list (`points`, `closed`) or every outline of a wired `path` layer (shapes, paths, glyph outlines). Modes: `each` trims every outline at once; `sequence` lays them end to end and trims the whole run, so they draw one after another (handwriting). Pieces come out as lines (a filled shape strokes in its fill colour unless `style` is wired). `heads` / `angles`: where each drawing end is and which way it heads, for a pen tip or an arrowhead.

nodes.label: Shape Morph
nodes.description: Blend the outlines of layer `a` into layer `b` by `t` (0 = a, 1 = b): shapes, paths or glyph outlines. Both are resampled to the same number of `points` (0 = automatic) and lined up so the blend doesn't twist; outer shapes pair with outer shapes and holes with holes, in order, and a contour with no partner shrinks to its centre. Fill / stroke colours and stroke weight blend too, unless `style` is wired.

nodes.label: Connect Points
nodes.description: Lines between nearby points (the plexus look). Modes: `distance` joins every pair closer than `distance` (each point keeps at most `maxLinks`, shortest first; 0 = no limit); `nearest` joins each point to its `neighbours` nearest (within `distance` when > 0). A line's `strength` falls from 1 (touching) to 0 (at the reach); `fade` takes that much off its alpha and `taper` off its width. Wire `colors` to colour the lines: `colorBy` `points` gives point i colour i (cycled), each line a gradient between its ends; `length` runs the colours from the shortest lines to those at the reach. Fast for thousands of points. Outputs the lines as one layer, and each line's ends and strength.

nodes.label: Contours
nodes.description: Isolines of a field as closed outlines (marching squares): topographic lines, metaballs, image outlines. Modes: `field` (a spread of `values`, `cols` a row, over `center` / `size` — e.g. noise on Grid positions), `points` (metaballs: Σ radius² / distance² of the `points`, sampled every `cell` units), `image` (brightness × alpha, 0..1, centred on `center` at `size`, 0 = pixel size), `shape` (distance from the outlines of a wired `shape`, sampled every `cell`: levels are distances, 0 = the outline, outward positive — rings round text or shapes, outer ones underneath). Draws `levels` contours at `threshold`, `threshold + step`, …; each level fills as one polygon with its holes (outside the field counts as low, so every contour closes). `levels` out: each contour's level. Wire `colors` to colour the levels (fill, else stroke): a palette from the first level to the last.

nodes.label: Simulation
nodes.description: A running simulation; pick it with `mode` and the pins follow. flocking: boids that separate, align and cohere on a wrapping field (`attract` pulls them to `target`). physarum: slime-mould agents following and laying a trail map, which comes out as `image` (angles in degrees, distances in grid cells; `food` points keep feeding the trail). dla: walkers sticking to a growing cluster from `seeds`, `rate` particles a second up to `count`. cloth: a Verlet spring mesh hanging from its `pin`s, with wind, tearing (`tear` × rest length) and `grab` to drag the point nearest `pointer`. `layer` draws it (shapes take `style`; `colors` ramps along `values`); `points`, `values` (heading, growth order or stretch) and the `from` / `to` line segments are there to draw your own. Steps 60 times per second of frame time, so the same seed and frames give the same result. A rising edge on `reset` starts over.

nodes.label: Gradient Fill
nodes.description: Fill (or stroke) downstream shapes with a linear, radial or conic gradient through the `colors` spread (evenly spaced, or at `positions` 0..1). `units`: `shape` places the geometry in each shape's own box (-1..1 across it, centre origin), `canvas` in scene units. `extend` says what happens past the ends: pad, repeat or mirror. The `mode` dropdown swaps the geometry pins (start / end, center / radius, center / angle in radians). Chain via `base` like Fill.

nodes.label: Mask
nodes.description: Show `layer` through `mask`: by the mask's alpha, or by its luminance (white shows, black hides). `invert` shows the layer where the mask is empty instead.

nodes.label: Effect
nodes.description: A post-effect on a layer, on the GPU. Pick the `mode`; the pins follow it. Sizes are in pixels, angles in radians. Light and texture: bloom (bright parts glow), film grain (animates by itself), displacement (by noise, or by a `map` layer: red pushes right, green down), ordered dither, colour halftone dots, chromatic aberration, vignette. Blur: `kind` gaussian, lens (bokeh discs; `highlights` opens bright points), motion (along `angle`), zoom (streaks towards `center`) or spin (round it). Shape: drop shadow and glow of the layer's coverage (`inner` puts them inside; glow `blend` add makes it light that adds, over the layer too), barrel / pincushion distortion, Sobel edges. Colour: posterize, threshold (by brightness into `low` / `high`, or `channel` alpha cuts the coverage — blur first for gooey metaballs), levels, curves (each colour pin is a point of the curve at black, ¼, ½, ¾ and white, per channel), lut (a `.cube` file: wire a File node's `url` or type a path), chroma key (with spill suppression).

nodes.label: Echo
nodes.description: Time effects on a layer, on the GPU. `trails`: each frame drawn over the last, which fades by `decay`. `echo`: `copies` earlier frames, `spacing` frames apart, each fainter by `decay`, under the live one. `delay`: the layer as it was `frames` frames ago. `freeze`: while `freeze` is on, hold the last frame shown. `slit-scan`: each row (or column) from a different moment — the edge `direction` points away from is now, the far edge `frames` ago. `reset` forgets the past. Past frames are kept at canvas size, at most 256 MB (240 frames).

nodes.label: Math
nodes.description: Arithmetic and maths functions in one node: pick `op` and the pins follow. add, subtract, multiply, divide, min and max take any number of inputs (number, vec2 or colour, component-wise); then mod, pow, negate, abs, sign, floor, ceil, round, fract, sqrt, square, exp, log, sin, cos, tan, asin, acos, atan, atan2, length of (x, y) and distance between two (x, y) points.

nodes.label: Vector Math
nodes.description: Vector operations in one node: pick `op` and the pins follow. length, distance, dot, angle-between and heading give a number; normalize, set-length, limit, scale, rotate, project and reflect give a vec2. (Adding, subtracting or multiplying vec2s: Math. Blending: Lerp.)

nodes.label: Compare
nodes.description: Compare a with b — less, less-equal, greater, greater-equal, equal or not-equal — as true / false.

nodes.label: Logic
nodes.description: Boolean logic: a and b, a or b, a xor b (exactly one true), or not x.

nodes.label: Statistics
nodes.description: One number from a number spread: its mean, median, sum, min, max or (population) standard deviation.

nodes.label: Convert
nodes.description: Convert a value `to` a number, an integer (rounded), a boolean or a string; or an angle to radians (from degrees) or to degrees (from a 0..1 turn).

nodes.label: Format Number
nodes.description: Numbers as text, for labels, counters and charts — every element of a spread. Modes: `number` (`decimals`, thousands `separator`, zero `pad` to that many integer digits, `sign` always shows + / −), `percent` (0.25 → 25%), `compact` (1.2k, 3.4M, 5.6B), `time` (seconds as m:ss, h:mm:ss from an hour, with `decimals` of a second). `prefix` / `suffix` add units or currency.

nodes.label: Layout
nodes.description: Arrange `count` items as a `grid` (`cols`, 0 = square-ish; `spacing`), a `ring` (`radius`, `start` angle, `sweep`: a full turn or an arc with items on both ends), a phyllotaxis `spiral` (`spacing`) or evenly along a `path` (a layer's outlines end to end, or `points`, `closed`). Outputs each item's position, angle (outwards on a ring or spiral, along a path) and scale. When `count`, the mode or `cols` changes, or the node is edited, the items ease to their new places over `duration` seconds (`easing`; `stagger` 0..1 starts later items later): new items grow in, removed ones shrink away where they are (the spreads are longer than `count` until the move ends). Animated inputs are followed exactly; `reset` jumps. `progress`: 0..1 through a move, 1 when settled.

nodes.label: Point Tracker
nodes.description: Follow points across the frames of a moving image (camera, video, a rendered layer) by pyramidal Lucas–Kanade optical flow. Tracks start at the wired `points` (canvas units: (0, 0) is the image's centre, y down) and start there again while `reset` is on, when the number of points changes or when they're edited; a point can move up to about `window` pixels a frame. `confidence` (0..1) is how well each window matched (it drops when the way back doesn't return, or there's nothing to lock onto); a lost point stays put at 0. Repeated frames are skipped; the tracks survive patch edits.
